title: Special Prosecutors Terms and Conditions Rules 2012

sections.shortTitle: Special Prosecutors Terms and Conditions Rules 2012
sections.section: RULES - Special Prosecutors (Terms and Conditions) Rules 2012
sections.description:
SPECIAL PROSECUTORS (TERMS AND
SPECIAL PROSECUTORS (TERMS AND
CONDITIONS) RULES, 2012)
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II,
9th June, 2012]
S.R.O. 721(I)/2012, dated 24-5-2012.---In exercise
of the power conferred by section 77 of the Control of Narcotics Substances
Act, 1997 (XXV of 1997), the Federal Government is pleased to make the
following rules, namely:--
1. Short
title and commencement.---(i)
These rules may be called the Special Prosecutors (Terms and Conditions) Rules,
2012.
(ii) They
shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.---In
these rule, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,-
(a) "Act"
means the Control of Narcotic Substances Act, 1997 (XXV of 1997);
(b) "Authorized
Officer" means the Secretary of the Division concerned, law officer of
Anti-Narcotics Force or an officer of the Division concerned duly authorized,
as the case may be;
(c) "Law
officer" means an officer of the Anti-Narcotics Force authorized by the
Director General to deal with court cases for prosecution under the Act; and
(d) "Special
Prosecutor" means a Special Prosecutor appointed under section 50 of the
Act on the terms and conditions specified in these rules.
3. Appointment
of Special Prosecutor.---(i) The Special Prosecutor shall be a person who
is a citizen of Pakistan and practicing as an advocate of a High Court with
experience in legal matters preferably of dealing with drug cases and criminal
cases etc., and shall neither have been guilty of misconduct during his
professional career nor convicted of any offence of moral turpitude nor
dismissed from Government service nor declared as an insolvent.
(ii) The
Special Prosecutor may be appointed by the Secretary of the Division concerned
in consultation with the Law and Justice Division on such monthly retainership
fee as may be agreed upon through an agreement executed between the special
prosecutor and the authorized officer in this behalf.
4. Terms
of appointment.---(i) The Special Prosecutor shall conduct proceedings
under the Act in narcotic cases on behalf of the Federal Government before
special courts and appellate courts and shall not appear in any narcotic case
in defence of an accused.
(ii) Government or intentionally does not pursue a
case assigned to him, his appointment may be terminated on two months prior
notice by the Secretary of the Division concerned.
(iii) A
Special Prosecutor may, by writing under his hand with either a notice of at
least two months in advance to the Secretary of the Division concerned of
forfeiting his retainership fee for the period falling short of the notice
period, terminate the agreement.
(iv) Where
a Special Prosecutor is appointed in a particular case, he shall be paid fifty
per cent of the fee in advance and the remaining amount shall be paid on
completion of the trial by the court including the appellate court as mutually
agreed.
(v) Where
a Special Prosecutor is required to attend a case outside the station of his
employment, he shall be entitled to travelling allowance in addition to his
retainership fee as per entitlement of an officer of Basic Pay Scale 20 for his
journey on official tour or as agreed otherwise.
(vi) The
Special Prosecutor shall attend regularly assigned cases in the courts and
intimate progress of each case to the concerned officer or law officer and
shall be available to them at an appointed day, time and venue for any
discussion or advice.
(vii) The
Special Prosecutor shall give advice to the law officers as may be required by
them on legal matters including drafting of appeals and preparation of parawise
comments on appeals filed in any court under the Act by or against the Federal
Government.
5. Repeal.---The
Special Prosecutor (Terms and Condition) Rules, 2001 are hereby repealed.
